brief: The LinkedIn content loop that built a 50K following in 6 months.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: The Content Loop Behind 50K Followers
slots.body: This repeatable system turned one idea into twelve posts weekly. No burnout. Just compounding growth.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Start With One Core Idea
slots.body: Every post begins with a single problem your audience faces daily. Solve it simply.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Break It Into Micro-Insights
slots.body: Turn that idea into five bite-sized tips. Each tip becomes its own slide.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Hook Them in Three Seconds
slots.body: Your first slide must stop the scroll. Use a bold claim or a counterintuitive truth.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Design for Mobile Reading
slots.body: Big font. White space. One idea per slide. If they squint, they scroll past.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Recycle Top Performers Monthly
slots.body: Double down on what worked. Repurpose your best carousel into a post, poll, or comment.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Close With a Clear CTA
slots.body: Tell readers exactly what to do next. Follow, comment, or save for later reference.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: Ready to Build Your Loop?
slots.body: Save this carousel and start your first loop today. Consistency beats perfection.
